pcs.pc_description: identify the cutting work to be done by interpreting the engineering drawing, Welding Procedure Specification (WPS) and job orders

identify the tools, cutting torch, machine, measuring instruments, accessories, consumables and input materials (mild carbon steel, high tensile and special steels, other materials) as per the requirements mentioned in WPS or drawing
select and arrange the right material, equipment, fixtures, accessories such as regulators, hoses and valve and consumables such as shielding gas etc. as per the SOP and job requirements
select the correct type of nozzle, consumables, gases and oxy-gas cutting equipment required for the job by following WPS and drawing
check the input material, tools, equipment and accessories for any defects, leakages and that they are as per the required quality standards
prepare the work area for cutting activities
set the oxy-gas cutting apparatus and its parameters as per the WPS and SOP
ensure that a flashback arrestor is fitted with the apparatus
use correct technique for lighting, adjusting and extinguishing the arc
adjust torch valve for the type of flame such as neutral, carburizing and oxidizing
mark the correct measurements on the workpiece by using appropriate tools and measuring instruments as specified in drawing or WPS
follow safety precautions during cutting work as per SOP and organizational guidelines
start the gas cutting machine for cutting operations
adjust cylinder valves and regulator for operating pressure to achieve required specifications
perform oxy-gas cutting process as per SOP and produce items/cut shapes to the dimensions and profiles specified in WPS and drawing

perform various cutting operations correctly and produce thermal cuts in various forms of material (metal of 3mm and above) which meet specified quality criteria i.e. dimensional accuracy is within the tolerances specified on the drawing/specification, or within +/- 2mm; angled/radial cuts are within specification requirements; cuts are clean and smooth and free from flutes; no drags
recognize and correct burn-back and flashback
measure the final workpiece and compare with the dimensions as prescribed in the WPS and engineering drawing
shut down the cutting equipment and remove the workpiece after completion of cutting activities
check the work pieces as per the work instructions for product quality
identify defects in the completed workpiece by using appropriate methods and equipment
separate the defective pieces which can be repaired/ reworked and pieces which are beyond repair
clean and store all the tools, machine and equipment after completion of work
check the machine operations for any malfunctions/defects in the component and immediately inform the supervisor/maintenance team for correction
dispose scrap or waste material in accordance with the company policies and environmental regulations
report to the supervisor about any problems faced or anticipated during the complete process

pcs.pc_description: identify the work to be done and product specifications by interpreting the product drawing, Welding Procedure Specification (WPS) and job orders
identify the tools, welding machines, measuring instruments, accessories, consumables and input materials (i.e. carbon, low alloy steel etc.) as per the requirements mentioned in WPS or drawing
select and arrange the right material, equipment, fixtures, accessories, welding torch and consumables i.e. electrode, filler wire, shielding gas etc. as per the SOP and job requirements
check the input material, tools and equipment for any defects and that they are as per the required quality standards
prepare the work area for the welding activities
prepare the materials (i.e. plate(1.5 - 24mm)/ sheet (1.5mm)) and joint for welding process
set the MMAW machine and its parameters as per the WPS and SOP
re-dry electrodes as per electrode classification requirement
install the work pieces and fixture on the apparatus and align them with the electrodes as per the job requirements
verify set up by running test weld specimen (scrap plate)
follow safety precautions during welding work as per SOP and organizational guidelines
start the MMAW machine for welding operations
strike and maintain a stable arc by applying correct technique (i.e. scratch start, tapping techniques) and to avoid welding defects
perform MMAW welding process as per SOP and tack weld the joint at appropriate intervals to produce joints of the specified quality, dimensions and profile
produce fillet and grove joints in 1F/1G, 2F/2G and 3F/ 3G welding positions as specified in WPS by using single or multi-run welds
ensure correct angle of torch, travel speed, direction of weld and feed during the welding operation
maintain proper bead sequence with respect to groove/fillet configurations and positions
monitor the welding process parameters (air pressure, electrode force, electrode distance, gas flow etc.) are within standards by reading the various gauges and correct them if not within standards
measure the final welded piece and compare with the dimensional and geometrical aspects of the weld as prescribed in the WPS and engineering drawing
remove extra material, slag etc. by using brush, chipping hammers, grinders etc., from the welded piece
hammer the work piece to get the desired shape, if there are any welding bulges/distortions
shut down the welding equipment and remove the workpiece after completion of welding activities
check the work pieces as per the work instructions for product quality
identify various weld defects by conducting visual inspection, destructive and non-destructive tests on the work pieces
separate the defective pieces which can be repaired/ reworked and pieces which are beyond repair
clean and store all the tools, machine and equipment after completion of work
dispose scrap or waste material in accordance with the company policies and environmental regulations
report to the supervisor about any problems faced or anticipated during the complete process
